verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

verses.original: וַתִּזְנֶ֣ינָה בְמִצְרַ֔יִם בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶ֖ן זָנ֑וּ שָׁ֚מָּה מֹעֲכ֣וּ שְׁדֵיהֶ֔ן וְשָׁ֣ם עִשּׂ֔וּ דַּדֵּ֖י בְּתוּלֵיהֶֽן׃

verses.original: וּשְׁמוֹתָ֗ן אָהֳלָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ וְאָהֳלִיבָ֣ה אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וַתִּֽהְיֶ֣ינָה לִ֔י וַתֵּלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת וּשְׁמוֹתָ֕ן שֹׁמְר֣וֹן אָהֳלָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָהֳלִיבָֽה׃

verses.original: וַתִּ֥זֶן אָהֳלָ֖ה תַּחְתָּ֑י וַתַּעְגַּב֙ עַֽל־ מְאַהֲבֶ֔יהָ אֶל־ אַשּׁ֖וּר קְרוֹבִֽים׃

verses.original: וְאֶת־ תַּזְנוּתֶ֤יהָ מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔בָה כִּ֤י אוֹתָהּ֙ שָׁכְב֣וּ בִנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וְהֵ֥מָּה עִשּׂ֖וּ דַּדֵּ֣י בְתוּלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּשְׁפְּכ֥וּ תַזְנוּתָ֖ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

verses.literal: Therefore Oholibah this is what the Lord GOD . . . says I will incite your lovers against you those from whom . . . you turned away in disgust And I will bring them against you from every side
verses.literalPt: Por isso, ó Aolibá, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu suscitarei contra ti os teus amantes, dos quais se tinha apartado a tua alma, e os trarei contra ti de toda a parte em derredor.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י בָבֶ֣ל וְכָל־ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים פְּק֤וֹד וְשׁ֙וֹעַ֙ וְק֔וֹעַ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתָ֑ם בַּח֨וּרֵי חֶ֜מֶד פַּח֤וֹת וּסְגָנִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם שָֽׁלִשִׁים֙ וּקְרוּאִ֔ים רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇā·ḇel wə·ḵāl kaś·dîm pə·qō·wḏ wə·šō·w·a‘ wə·qō·w·a‘ kāl- bə·nê ’aš·šūr ’ō·w·ṯām ba·ḥū·rê ḥe·meḏ pa·ḥō·wṯ ū·sə·ḡā·nîm kul·lām šā·li·šîm ū·qə·rū·’îm rō·ḵə·ḇê sū·sîm kul·lām
verses.literal: the Babylonians . . . and all the Chaldeans the men of Pekod Shoa and Koa and all the Assyrians . . . with them all desirable young men governors and commanders officers and men of renown mounted on horses
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Babilônia, e todos os caldeus de Pecode, e de Soa, e de Coa, e todos os filhos da Assíria com eles, jovens cobiçáveis, capitães e magistrados todos eles, grandes e afamados senhores, todos eles montados a cavalo.

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ עָלַ֡יִךְ הֹ֠צֶן רֶ֤כֶב וְגַלְגַּל֙ וּבִקְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֔ים צִנָּ֤ה וּמָגֵן֙ וְקוֹבַ֔ע יָשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלַ֖יִךְ סָבִ֑יב וְנָתַתִּ֤י לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּשְׁפָט֖וּךְ בְּמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·la·yiḵ hō·ṣen re·ḵeḇ wə·ḡal·gal ū·ḇiq·hal ‘am·mîm ṣin·nāh ū·mā·ḡên wə·qō·w·ḇa‘ yā·śî·mū ‘ā·la·yiḵ sā·ḇîḇ wə·nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·hem miš·pāṭ ū·šə·p̄ā·ṭūḵ bə·miš·pə·ṭê·hem
verses.literal: They will come against you with a host of peoples with weapons chariots and wagons They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet I will delegate judgment to them and they will punish you according to their own standards
verses.literalPt: E virão contra ti com carros, carretas e rodas, e com multidão de povos; e se colocarão contra ti em redor com paveses, e escudos e capacetes; e porei diante deles o juízo, e julgar-te-ão segundo os seus juízos.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י קִנְאָתִ֜י בָּ֗ךְ וְעָשׂ֤וּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּחֵמָ֔ה אַפֵּ֤ךְ וְאָזְנַ֙יִךְ֙ יָסִ֔ירוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפּ֑וֹל הֵ֗מָּה בָּנַ֤יִךְ וּבְנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ תֵּאָכֵ֥ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî qin·’ā·ṯî bāḵ wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·ḥê·māh ’ap·pêḵ wə·’ā·zə·na·yiḵ yā·sî·rū wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯêḵ ba·ḥe·reḇ tip·pō·wl hêm·māh bā·na·yiḵ ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ yiq·qā·ḥū wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯêḵ tê·’ā·ḵêl bā·’êš
verses.literal: And I will set My jealous rage against you and they will deal with you in fury They will cut off your noses and ears and your survivors will fall by the sword They will seize your sons and daughters and your remnant will be consumed by fire
verses.literalPt: E porei contra ti o meu zelo, e usarão de indignação contigo. Tirar-te-ão o nariz e as orelhas, e o que restar cairá à espada. Eles tomarão teus filhos e tuas filhas, e o que ficar por último em ti será consumido pelo fogo.

verses.original: וְהִפְשִׁיט֖וּךְ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י תִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hip̄·šî·ṭūḵ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏā·yiḵ wə·lā·qə·ḥū kə·lê ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ
verses.literal: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry
verses.literalPt: Também te despirão as tuas vestes, e te tomarão as tuas belas jóias.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י זִמָּתֵךְ֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וְאֶת־ זְנוּתֵ֖ךְ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׂאִ֤י עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־ עֽוֹד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî zim·mā·ṯêḵ mim·mêḵ wə·’eṯ- zə·nū·ṯêḵ mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·lō- ṯiś·’î ‘ê·na·yiḵ ’ă·lê·hem ū·miṣ·ra·yim lō ṯiz·kə·rî- ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: So I will put an end to your indecency and prostitution which began in the land of Egypt and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt . . . anymore
verses.literalPt: Assim farei cessar em ti a tua perversidade e a tua prostituição trazida da terra do Egito; e não levantarás os teus olhos para eles, nem te lembrarás nunca mais do Egito.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ נֹֽתְנָ֔ךְ בְּיַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את בְּיַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯə·nāḵ bə·yaḏ ’ă·šer śā·nêṯ bə·yaḏ ’ă·šer- nā·qə·‘āh nap̄·šêḵ mê·hem
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Surely I will deliver you into the hands of those you hate . . . from whom you turned away . . . in disgust
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu te entregarei na mão dos que odeias, na mão daqueles de quem tem se apartado a tua alma.

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּשִׂנְאָ֗ה וְלָקְחוּ֙ כָּל־ יְגִיעֵ֔ךְ וַעֲזָב֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֑ה וְנִגְלָה֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת זְנוּנַ֔יִךְ וְזִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·śin·’āh wə·lā·qə·ḥū kāl- yə·ḡî·‘êḵ wa·‘ă·zā·ḇūḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh wə·niḡ·lāh ‘er·waṯ zə·nū·na·yiḵ wə·zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·ṯaz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: They will treat . . . you with hatred take all for which you have worked and leave you naked and bare so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed Your indecency and promiscuity
verses.literalPt: E eles te tratarão com ódio, e levarão todo o fruto do teu trabalho, e te deixarão nua e despida; e descobrir-se-á a vergonha da tua prostituição, e a tua perversidade, e as tuas devassidões.

verses.original: עָשֹׂ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִטְמֵ֖את בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śōh ’êl·leh lāḵ biz·nō·w·ṯêḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ḡō·w·yim ‘al ’ă·šer- niṭ·mêṯ bə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem
verses.literal: have brought these things upon you because you have prostituted yourself with the nations . . . and defiled yourself with their idols
verses.literalPt: Estas coisas se te farão, porque te prostituíste após os gentios, e te contaminaste com os seus ídolos.

verses.original: בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֖ךְ הָלָ֑כְתְּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י כוֹסָ֖הּ בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ hā·lā·ḵət wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḵō·w·sāh bə·yā·ḏêḵ
verses.literal: Because you have followed the path of your sister I will put her cup into your hand
verses.literalPt: No caminho de tua irmã andaste; por isso entregarei o seu cálice na tua mão.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה כּ֤וֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ֙ תִּשְׁתִּ֔י הָעֲמֻקָּ֖ה וְהָרְחָבָ֑ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לִצְחֹ֛ק וּלְלַ֖עַג מִרְבָּ֥ה לְהָכִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kō·ws ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ tiš·tî hā·‘ă·muq·qāh wə·hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh tih·yeh liṣ·ḥōq ū·lə·la·‘aḡ mir·bāh lə·hā·ḵîl
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says You will drink your sister’s cup a cup deep and wide It will bring scorn and derision for it holds so much
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Beberás o cálice de tua irmã, fundo e largo; servirás de riso e escárnio; pois nele cabe muito.

verses.original: שִׁכָּר֥וֹן וְיָג֖וֹן תִּמָּלֵ֑אִי כּ֚וֹס שַׁמָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָ֔ה כּ֖וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ֥ךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šik·kā·rō·wn wə·yā·ḡō·wn tim·mā·lê·’î kō·ws šam·māh ū·šə·mā·māh kō·ws ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief with a cup of devastation and desolation the cup of your sister Samaria
verses.literalPt: De embriaguez e de dor te encherás; o cálice de tua irmã Samaria é cálice de espanto e de assolação.

verses.original: וְשָׁתִ֨ית אוֹתָ֜הּ וּמָצִ֗ית וְאֶת־ חֲרָשֶׂ֛יהָ תְּגָרֵ֖מִי וְשָׁדַ֣יִךְ תְּנַתֵּ֑קִי כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ṯîṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh ū·mā·ṣîṯ wə·’eṯ- ḥă·rā·śe·hā tə·ḡā·rê·mî wə·šā·ḏa·yiḵ tə·nat·tê·qî kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will drink it and drain it you will dash it to pieces and tear your breasts For I have spoken declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Bebê-lo-ás, pois, e esgotá-lo-ás, e os seus cacos roerás, e os teus seios arrancarás; porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּשְׁלִ֥יכִי אוֹתִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־ אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an šā·ḵa·ḥat ’ō·w·ṯî wat·taš·lî·ḵî ’ō·w·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê ḡaw·wêḵ wə·ḡam- ’at śə·’î zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back . . . you must bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Como te esqueceste de mim, e me lançaste para trás das tuas costas, também carregarás com a tua perversidade e as tuas devassidões.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת־ אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְהַגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām hă·ṯiš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lāh wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lî·ḇāh wə·hag·gêḏ lā·hen ’êṯ ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hen
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Son of man will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah Then declare to them their abominations
verses.literalPt: Disse-me ainda o SENHOR: Filho do homem, porventura julgarás tu a Aolá e a Aolibá? Mostra-lhes, pois, as suas abominações.

verses.original: כִּ֣י נִאֵ֗פוּ וְדָם֙ בִּֽידֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֶת־ גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ן נִאֵ֑פוּ וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָֽלְדוּ־ לִ֔י הֶעֱבִ֥ירוּ לָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ni·’ê·p̄ū wə·ḏām bî·ḏê·hen wə·’eṯ- gil·lū·lê·hen ni·’ê·p̄ū wə·ḡam ’eṯ- bə·nê·hen ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏū- lî he·‘ĕ·ḇî·rū lā·hem lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: For they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands . . . They have committed adultery with their idols They have even sacrificed their children whom they bore to Me in the fire as food for their idols
verses.literalPt: Porque adulteraram, e sangue se acha nas suas mãos, e com os seus ídolos adulteraram, e até os seus filhos, que de mim geraram, fizeram passar pelo fogo, para os consumir.

verses.original: ע֥וֹד זֹ֖את עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֑י טִמְּא֤וּ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ zōṯ ‘ā·śū lî ṭim·mə·’ū ’eṯ- miq·dā·šî bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay ḥil·lê·lū
verses.literal: They have also done this to Me On that very same day they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths
verses.literalPt: E ainda isto me fizeram: contaminaram o meu santuário no mesmo dia, e profanaram os meus sábados.

verses.original: וּֽבְשַׁחֲטָ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ לְגִלּ֣וּלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לְחַלְּל֑וֹ וְהִנֵּה־ כֹ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ša·ḥă·ṭām ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem lə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- miq·dā·šî bay·yō·wm ha·hū lə·ḥal·lə·lōw wə·hin·nêh- ḵōh ‘ā·śū bə·ṯō·wḵ bê·ṯî
verses.literal: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols they entered . . . My sanctuary to profane it Yes they did this inside My house
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, havendo sacrificado seus filhos aos seus ídolos, vinham ao meu santuário no mesmo dia para o profanarem; e eis que assim fizeram no meio da minha casa.

verses.original: וְאַ֗ף כִּ֤י תִשְׁלַ֙חְנָה֙ לַֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַלְאָ֜ךְ שָׁל֤וּחַ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְהִנֵּה־ בָ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָחַ֛צְתְּ כָּחַ֥לְתְּ עֵינַ֖יִךְ וְעָ֥דִית עֶֽדִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ kî ṯiš·laḥ·nāh la·’ă·nā·šîm bā·’îm mim·mer·ḥāq ’ă·šer mal·’āḵ šā·lū·aḥ ’ă·lê·hem wə·hin·nêh- ḇā·’ū la·’ă·šer rā·ḥaṣt kā·ḥalt ‘ê·na·yiḵ wə·‘ā·ḏîṯ ‘e·ḏî
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . you sisters sent messengers - for men who came from afar and behold when they arrived you bathed for them painted your eyes and adorned yourself with jewelry
verses.literalPt: E, mais ainda, mandaram vir alguns homens, de longe, aos quais fora enviado um mensageiro, e eis que vieram. Por amor deles te lavaste, coloriste os teus olhos, e te ornaste de enfeites.

verses.original: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ֙ עַל־ מִטָּ֣ה כְבוּדָּ֔ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֥ן עָר֖וּךְ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וּקְטָרְתִּ֥י וְשַׁמְנִ֖י שַׂ֥מְתְּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇt ‘al- miṭ·ṭāh ḵə·ḇū·dāh wə·šul·ḥān ‘ā·rūḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·hā ū·qə·ṭā·rə·tî wə·šam·nî śamt ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it on which you had set My incense and My oil
verses.literalPt: E te assentaste sobre um leito de honra, diante do qual estava uma mesa preparada; e puseste sobre ela o meu incenso e o meu azeite.

verses.original: וְק֣וֹל הָמוֹן֮ שָׁלֵ֣ו בָהּ֒ וְאֶל־ אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵרֹ֣ב אָדָ֔ם מוּבָאִ֥ים סוֹבָאִים מִמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּתְּנ֤וּ צְמִידִים֙ אֶל־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ן וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qō·wl hā·mō·wn šā·lêw ḇāh wə·’el- ’ă·nā·šîm mê·rōḇ ’ā·ḏām mū·ḇā·’îm sō·ḇå̄·ʾīm mim·miḏ·bār way·yit·tə·nū ṣə·mî·ḏîm ’el- yə·ḏê·hen wa·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ ‘al- rā·šê·hen
verses.literal: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble . . . who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head
verses.literalPt: Com ela se ouvia a voz de uma multidão satisfeita; com homens de classe baixa foram trazidos beberrões do deserto; e puseram braceletes nas mãos das mulheres e coroas de esplendor nas suas cabeças.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לַבָּלָ֖ה נִֽאוּפִ֑ים עַתָּ יִזְנֻה תַזְנוּתֶ֖הָ וָהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lab·bā·lāh ni·’ū·p̄îm ʿa·tå̄ yiz·nuh ṯaz·nū·ṯe·hā wā·hî
verses.literal: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries Now let them use her as a prostitute . . . for that is all she is
verses.literalPt: Então disse à envelhecida em adultérios: Agora deveras se prostituirão com ela, e ela com eles?

verses.original: וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֔יהָ כְּב֖וֹא אֶל־ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן בָּ֗אוּ אֶֽל־ אָֽהֳלָה֙ וְאֶל־ אָ֣הֳלִיבָ֔ה אִשֹּׁ֖ת הַזִּמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·hā kə·ḇō·w ’el- ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh kên bā·’ū ’el- ’ā·ho·lāh wə·’el- ’ā·ho·lî·ḇāh ’iš·šōṯ haz·zim·māh
verses.literal: And they slept with her as with a prostitute . . . they slept with . . . Oholah . . . and Oholibah those lewd women
verses.literalPt: E entraram a ela, como quem entra a uma prostituta; assim entraram a Aolá e a Aolibá, mulheres infames.

verses.original: וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים צַדִּיקִ֗ם הֵ֚מָּה יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ אֽוֹתְהֶ֔ם מִשְׁפַּט֙ נֹֽאֲפ֔וֹת וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט שֹׁפְכ֣וֹת דָּ֑ם כִּ֤י נֹֽאֲפֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְדָ֖ם בִּֽידֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nā·šîm ṣad·dî·qim hêm·māh yiš·pə·ṭū ’ō·wṯ·hem miš·paṭ nō·’ă·p̄ō·wṯ ū·miš·paṭ šō·p̄ə·ḵō·wṯ dām kî nō·’ă·p̄ōṯ hên·nāh wə·ḏām bî·ḏê·hen
verses.literal: But righteous . . . men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed . . . . . . because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands
verses.literalPt: De maneira que homens justos as julgarão como se julgam as adúlteras, e como se julgam as que derramam sangue; porque são adúlteras, e sangue há nas suas mãos.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הַעֲלֵ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קָהָ֔ל וְנָתֹ֥ן אֶתְהֶ֖ן לְזַעֲוָ֥ה וְלָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: kî kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ha·‘ă·lêh ‘ă·lê·hem qā·hāl wə·nā·ṯōn ’eṯ·hen lə·za·‘ă·wāh wə·lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD . . . says Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei subir contra elas uma multidão, e as entregarei ao desterro e ao saque.

verses.original: וְרָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ן אֶ֙בֶן֙ קָהָ֔ל וּבָרֵ֥א אוֹתְהֶ֖ן בְּחַרְבוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ן בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḡə·mū ‘ă·lê·hen ’e·ḇen qā·hāl ū·ḇā·rê ’ō·wṯ·hen bə·ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām bə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem ya·hă·rō·ḡū ū·ḇāt·tê·hen bā·’êš yiś·rō·p̄ū
verses.literal: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses
verses.literalPt: E a multidão as apedrejará, e as golpeará com as suas espadas; eles a seus filhos e a suas filhas matarão, e as suas casas queimarão a fogo.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנִֽוַּסְּרוּ֙ כָּל־ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî zim·māh min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niw·was·sə·rū kāl- han·nā·šîm wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śe·nāh kə·zim·maṯ·ḵe·nāh
verses.literal: So I will put an end to indecency in the land and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior
verses.literalPt: Assim farei cessar a perversidade da terra, para que se escarmentem todas as mulheres, e não façam conforme a vossa perversidade;

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְכֶ֙נָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ן וַחֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯə·nū zim·maṯ·ḵe·nāh ‘ă·lê·ḵen wa·ḥă·ṭā·’ê ḡil·lū·lê·ḵen tiś·śe·nāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will repay you for your indecency . . . and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: O castigo da vossa perversidade eles farão recair sobre vós, e levareis os pecados dos vossos ídolos; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
